verdict.rationale: Apify documents launching Actor runs programmatically through JS/Python clients with asyncio support, storing multiple input configurations as tasks, and managing sessions through SessionPool with datacenter/residential proxy rotation. Together these suggest many scraping sessions can run at scale, but no item explicitly documents running many runs concurrently or scaling behavior. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrent/parallel Actor runs and concurrency limits, autoscaling or crawler concurrency controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale concurrent scraping.
